layout.structure: minimal header ('Course Quiz' + Save/Cancel) -> ReorderableList of questions -> 'Add Question' -> Save

content: ReorderableList: each question = prompt TextField, 2-4 option TextFields, 'mark correct' selector

states.empty: 'no questions yet' + CTA 'Add Question' (lightweight in-context prompt, not a full EmptyState)
states.error: inline validation (e.g. 'mark a correct answer before saving')

accessibilityRule: same reordering accessibility guarantee as Course Editor Curriculum — Move Up/Down always present per question
rtlBehavior: same pattern as Course Editor — Curriculum
knownGaps: No showcase mockup exists — judged against design-system component specs only.
